messages:
Maya: FYI - customers reporting they didn't get pages ~20m ago. Oncall didn't get anything either. Anyone seeing alerts?
incident-bot: suppressed 23 pages for route 'pager-relay' due to downstream error 502 from notify-gateway. Suppression window active.
Linh: I can confirm increased error rate on notify-gateway. 502s started ~1718233400.
Sam: Queue depth looks bad on redis:notify:queue. quick check: `redis-cli -h redis-primary LLEN notify:queue` -> 12432
Jorge: looks like our paging bridge stopped handshaking with outbound provider after auth refresh failed. Logs show repeated `401 handshake` from pagerflow-client.
Maya: ugh. Does incident-bot have a fallback configured?
incident-bot: fallback route 'pagerflow-fallback' exists but last successful delivery via fallback was 1718232600. Fallback also failing with TLS handshake error.
Dave: Can someone run the quick mitigation in the runbook: force-reset the bridge auth cache and flip to emergency-relay? Steps:
```
# on bridge host
sudo systemctl restart pager-bridge
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://ops.internal/relay/switch -d '{"route":"emergency-sms-relay"}'
```
Jorge: I'll take bridge restart. Doing `sudo systemctl restart pager-bridge` now.
ops-bot: pager-bridge restart initiated by Jorge at 1718234702. Healthcheck ping returning 200 after 8s.
Jorge: bridge logs show auth token fetch failing then succeeding after restart. Still seeing backlog in Redis, need to drain.
Sam: draining queue now with small batch workers: `python tools/drain_queue.py --max 5000 --route emergency-sms-relay`
Linh: to confirm, switching incident-bot suppression rules to allow immediate retries for oncall routes. Doing that now.
incident-bot: suppression window reduced to 10s for routes: oncall, pager.
Maya: good. Can someone check if oncall got a page?
Dave: I just triggered a test page to current oncall using `/ops page-test` — oncall acknowledged in 3s.
Maya: nice. Any customer-facing impact we should note?
Sam: Post-drain metrics show 11k items processed, delivery success rate now 99.6%. A subset of customers had delays ~20-40m; no missed final escalation (all got pages after mitigation).
Jorge: assigning follow-up: I'll open a postmortem and include: auth token rotation gap, fallback routing not healthy, suppression thresholds too aggressive.
Maya: agreed. Priya from CS will send customer notifications for delayed pages. cc: @Priya (not in thread).
Dave: adding temporary alert to detect suppression backpressure to avoid silent windows.
Linh: thanks all, keeping this thread open until postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
